title: Apple Seeks Preliminary Injunction Against OpenAI in Trade Secrets Case
content_html:
Apple Seeks Preliminary Injunction Against OpenAI in Trade Secrets Case

Reuters:

Apple on Monday asked a U.S. judge for a preliminary injunction barring two former employees ​and OpenAI from accessing, acquiring, using or disclosing alleged confidential information as it moves ahead with its trade secrets case. [...]

The iPhone maker also filed a concurrent motion on Monday seeking expedited discovery, including production of documents relating to the defendants’ alleged access ​of Apple’s proprietary and trade secret information. It asked the judge to order the two ​former Apple employees named in the lawsuit, Chang Liu and Tang Yew Tan, to sit for depositions, along with OpenAI employee Yu-Ting Peng and an unnamed OpenAI employee who previously worked at ​Apple.

The request for expedited discovery and the depositions, I understand. Apple wants to move fast, and they want to get depositions (especially, I’m sure, with Tan) now. The preliminary injunction request, though, I think Reuters is underplaying here.

I suggest reading Apple’s actual motion, not the news coverage. From Apple’s motion:

OpenAI, its people, and partners should not be permitted to develop, release, and benefit from products using and developed with the benefit of Apple’s trade secrets.

★ Tuesday, 4 August 2026

content_html_zh:
苹果在商业秘密案中寻求针对 OpenAI 的初步禁令
路透社：苹果公司周一请求美国法官发布初步禁令，禁止两名前员工和 OpenAI 在推进其商业机密案件时访问、获取、使用或披露所谓的机密信息。 [...] 这家 iPhone 制造商还在周一同时提出了一项动议，寻求加快证据开示，包括提供与被告涉嫌访问苹果专有和商业秘密信息相关的文件。 它要求法官命令诉讼中提到的两名前苹果员工 Chang Liu 和 Tang Yew Tan 以及 OpenAI 员工 Yu-Ting Peng 和一名曾在苹果工作过的未透露姓名的 OpenAI 员工出庭作证。 我理解加快证据开示和证词的要求。 苹果公司希望迅速采取行动，他们现在希望获得证词（特别是，我确信，谭）。 不过，我认为路透社对初步禁令请求的重视程度不够。 我建议阅读苹果的实际动议，而不是新闻报道。 苹果的动议称：OpenAI、其员工和合作伙伴不应被允许开发、发布利用苹果商业秘密开发的产品并从中受益。 ★ 2026 年 8 月 4 日，星期二
